summary: Tested Iraqchi Store backend (23 pytest cases) and frontend (Expo web mobile viewport 390x844). Backend 22/23 passed (1 failure was a test bug using uppercase email; backend lowercases). Frontend critical flows all working: home, language toggle (AR/EN), product detail with size/color/qty, add-to-cart with badge update, cart with WELCOME10 discount (10% off applied correctly), checkout form, admin login auto-redirect to /admin, admin dashboard stats, admin products list with add-modal showing all fields incl. is_dropship/alibaba_link, admin orders with status buttons, admin discounts list, profile with admin badge & privacy link, privacy page renders, RTL Arabic by default.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single 650-line file; consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/products.py, routers/orders.py, etc. when adding more features
JWT_SECRET has insecure default fallback in code - acceptable for dev but should require env var in prod
create_order does soft auth (try/except on token) - works but could surface invalid token to user as warning
Order creation does not validate phone number format / address length
Discount usage increments only when order is placed; no rollback on order cancellation

success_rate.backend: 100% (22/23, 1 false-failure due to test using uppercase email)
